venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.weather: Highs in the low 90s, lows in the 70s overnight
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Mon 9/14.** MOD: JK (standby). Net $957 vs $768 target (+24.6%); food $252; comps $19.50; 23 guests // $41.61 check avg. Quiet until early evening, then a bit of guest flow with a small pop around 10pm. Smooth night; bar staff completed cleaning projects. 15 Meal Deals sold on the first Meal Deal Monday — updated table tents on the way. Opener left ~8:30pm, no barback. Kitchen: keep new activations (Meal Deal Mondays, Thursday Night Football) in mind for weekly prep. Maintenance: third bathroom door lock — email sent to handyman. No incidents; no no-shows charged. Entered by JK (posted 9/15 8:23am PT).

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Mon 9/14 (MOD KE, Chef DM).** Net $1,112 vs $1,200 target (93%); food $88; comps $26 (2.37%); 43 guests / $25.85 avg. An okay Monday made a happy shift by Edy's return to the team — impeccable guest rapport, perfect drink specs, beautiful garnishes. Lots of return guests, including folks on their second or third visit bringing friends. "Meal Deal Monday" got little traction; most guests were coming from or headed to dinner. Kitchen: smooth. 86'd: Guinness draft (cans available), veggie dogs. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: industry visitors Molly and Jinn from Birmingham who said they'd change where they stay in Nashville to be closer to us. Entered by BT.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Mon 9/14 (AM Carey; PM Maggie H, Chef Rachel).** Total net $6,651.27 vs $6,888 target (97% — "we were so close"); DC/AM $900.87, D&C PM $5,750.40; no events; total food $1,462.60; comps $284; 154 guests (Tock) / ~$43.19 avg. AM: truly mellow all day; miso sesame is back; 86 evergreen, strawberry. PM: cut just about everyone possible early (Josh by 8p, Morgan/Kyle 9:30p, Minsu before 10p) — big shoutout to Minsu, Sam and Graham. Kitchen: early pop then quiet; garden food slow, gameday crowd only got oysters; pesto shelf-life issue flagged (thrown out day 8); low on mango tarts, spinach dip, cocktail sauce, rabbit agnolotti, steaks, cherry vermouth reduction; 911 pesto, rabbit farce; 86 scallops. Events: Datadog workshop tomorrow, 40 guests 2:30–7pm in Vauxhall + Garden (coffee/hot water/creamers ready 2:30). Break make-up complete; no-shows not charged; no incidents. Favorite moment: a 16-top of hotel guests at 9:45p who booked again for tomorrow. Entered by MJH.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Mon 9/14 (MOD Kyler, Chef Tenzin).** Total EOD net $3,439 vs $3,560 target (97%); food $133, beverage $3,439; comps $100.94; 110 covers (SevenRooms) / $31 avg; 1 large party, 6 solos, 2 investor cocktails. Smooth, relaxed service with a constant trickle tapering after 10pm, briefly full 9–10:30pm; unusually date-oriented crowd (only four parties >2). Chilly 62° evening, slow post-NYFW Monday. Guests included Natasha and Carlo from Batemans, Kyle (bev director, Artemis), a DoorDash content creator filming TikToks, and several Seattle visitors excited for the new location; 2 birthdays, 2 anniversaries. Top sellers: Shinebox, Burner Phone, Cloudwalk. Menu count 17; breakage 1 tulip, 1 Collins. Incident: a guest after last call lightly cut his thumb/index finger on a Collins — treated on site. No no-shows. Entered by Thomas.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.weather: warm but not as warm as previous nights
venues.narrative: **LA — Mon 9/14 (MOD Mikey, Jersh, Angel).** Net $4,085 vs $3,560 target (115%); food $1,050; all Marquee (standing room $0); comps $113 (industry Jesus & Nikki, Nancy, regulars Raff & Clarissa); 103 guests / $83.36 reported avg. Steady start with 25 covers on the books; room filled 8:15–9pm, good flow all night with a brief waitlist; many 3-top walk-ins kept the floor a Tetris game — Ariana handled it well. Last res 11:15pm. Rafa and Clarissa inquired about a buy-out for Rafa's 30th (given GG's card). An applicant (Peter) came in for a second interview that may have been a duplicate outreach mishap. Kitchen: sold out all Seacups, moved to Pacific Gold oysters; 86 Lamburger; low tartare and cookies (back tomorrow). No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: catching up with Jesus and his wife at EON. Entered by Mikey.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Mon 9/14 (MOD Josh / Jesse).** Total net incl. events $2,894.13 vs $2,314 target (125%); Marquee bar $2,894.13; food $230; no events; comps $2.64 (0.09%), voids $10; 63 guests (16 resys / 47 walk-ins) / $45.94 avg. Slow start, picked up nicely around 8:30pm with the room about half full; skeleton crew kept energy high with great comms. Negroni Week kicked off with a bang and was well received (drinks populate on every KDS, otherwise no system kinks). Kitchen: very chill, downtime used to ABK and prep for this week's events. Went well: communication, hustle, teamwork. Improve: resetting to zero, water service. Maintenance: deck panels in front of the door. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: industry friends from Good Lion Hospitality (LA) visiting. Entered by Jesse.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Mon 9/14 (AM Franck & Shannon; PM Justin & Marcus).** Total net $5,688 vs $3,584 target (159%); Municipal Bar AM $1,588 / PM $3,864, Sun Club $189, Hot Eye $0; food $2,418; comps $235.40; 144 guests (OpenTable 44 AM + 100 PM) / ~$39.50 avg. AM: quick pop of hotel guests at open, chill until ~1pm when walk-ins coincided with two larger tours; quiet by 3. PM: quiet first half (cut to two servers by 7:30), then steady even-paced pickup that ran past 11 — a later Monday. Amelia's first day back; Estella, Aleeza and Jon in training. Sun Club: hot and breezy, loungers not drinkers. Kitchen: 86 mousse. Incident/injury reported: Yes (no details in form). Favorite moment: Amber Capps filming happy-hour content for a post dropping tomorrow. Entered by Justin.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Mon 9/14 (MOD Curtis Hayes).** Net $9,495 vs $6,000 target (158%); food $1,448; comps $317.85 (3.3% incl. shifties); check avg $51.23 (guest count not reported). Close to a 10K night on cruise control — whole team showed out. Two-server floor team finding its groove with great reviews on attentiveness; bar team held it down with members and industry folks showing love. Nightfall is earlier so 7:30 is becoming prime time to draw the drapes; need a curated playlist (current ones swing from vibe-heavy to dead quiet). Malachi killed it on door. Kitchen: Josh did just shy of $1,500; quick interview with a promising part-time candidate. Maintenance: kitchen dishwasher plunger element broke — jury-rigged with zip ties. 86'd/low: yuzu juice, Tenth Planet, New Wind. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: Table 31 birthday vibes. Entered by Curtis Hayes.
